# Feeding journal

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/feeding-journal/

Record feeding times, optional amounts and notes in a private session. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Log a bottle feed at 09:30 with an optional amount and export the record as CSV.

## Limits and checks

The journal records what you enter and does not recommend feeding quantities. Data stays in this session unless you export it.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
